board: MAX31820MCR+ bare chip in 3-pin TO-92 (Maxim/Analog Devices), pins GND, DQ, VDD
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring with auto-added 4.7 kOhm DQ pull-up, design checks, breadboard, simulator test at 31.5 C, PCB DRC, TO-92_Inline footprint). Family 28h and the 12-bit 0.0625 C two's-complement register from the datasheet are read with MicroPython's built-in ds18x20 module, so no custom driver is needed; supply limited to the datasheet's 3.0-3.7 V.
